conversation.opening:
Hi, I’m Mira. It’s nice to meet you.

I’m here to help you tell your story, one memory at a time. You don’t need to remember everything, and there’s no right place to begin. I’ll ask a few simple questions, listen to what comes to mind, and sometimes show you old photos, places, or things from the past that might bring back a memory.

We’ll take it slowly, and you can skip anything you don’t feel like talking about.

First, what would you like me to call you?
conversation.resume: Welcome back. Your private profile and memories are ready; continue wherever the story leads.
conversation.fallback: I’m here with you—continue wherever the story leads.
conversation.publicCueFollowUp: Those public references are only prompts. Continue with whichever detail feels true to your memory.
conversation.memoryFollowUp: Thank you for sharing that. Continue with whichever part of the memory feels most present.
conversation.memoryComplete: Thank you. I have enough detail to shape the first chapter. Save this memory when it feels right.
conversation.publicContext: While you think, I found a few public historical references from that broad place and period. See if any feeling or detail comes back; you can also ignore them.
conversation.profileSaveError: Profile context was saved to Codex, but the project profile could not be updated: {error}
conversation.chapterDecisionFree: This memory has enough shape to become the first chapter. It is free, and I’ll open the workspace after you finish it.
conversation.chapterDecisionNew: I think this begins {title}. I’ll keep it as a separate chapter.
conversation.chapterDecisionCurrent: I’ll keep this memory with the current chapter.
conversation.chapterFreeFinished: Chapter one is finished, and it’s yours. I’ve opened the workspace beside us so you can keep the chapter, family tree, timeline, diary notes, and photos in view.
conversation.chapterFinished: Chapter {number} is finished. I’ll keep the workspace open while we continue.
conversation.cueDifferent: Got it — your life stays the authority.
conversation.cueSaved: Saved as a memory prompt, not a fact.
conversation.voiceAnswerFailed: That voice answer could not be processed.
